executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains tense. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and Enterprise SSD are currently among the most constrained segments. The Daily Check dated 2026-08-21 reviewed 8 relevant current reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
